Gravel bike tour Gravel tour around the Tschirgant massif

Imst / Lechtal Alps
Difficulty ratings: medium
Route length: 56.0 km

Colorful meadows, sparse forests and small hamlets characterize the varied gravel route from Imst. Fantastic distant views of the Mieminger mountains guaranteed.

Tour character

This medium-difficulty circular tour winds its way along varied gravel and forest paths through the idyllic Gurltal valley and then touches the sun-drenched Mieminger Plateau. You cycle back at a leisurely pace on the long-distance cycle path along the Inn. A little fitness is required, but the tour is technically easy.

Tour information

  • Requirement: medium
  • Length: 56.0 km
  • Elevation uphill:691 hm

Description

Whether on an e-bike or a classic bike, the ride around the Tschirgant massif requires a bit of fitness, but offers plenty of scenic variety. The bike tour through the picturesque scenery leaves lasting impressions of the countryside:

From spring to autumn, passages through the larch forests and meadows, the Inn gorge and the apple orchards near Haiming define the character of the Tschirgant circular tour.

The fantastic view of the Mieminger Plateau highlights the scenic beauty of the region. The starting point of the circular tour is in Imst, from where the tour leads along the Inn Cycle Path along the Inn river via Mötz to the Mieminger Plateau.

The descent after Arzkasten takes you to Nassereith and you can return to Imst via the Via Claudia Augusta and the idyllic Gurgltal valley.
